description: ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 check digit. Spaces and hyphens are ignored, and a 9-digit number is read as an ISBN-10 with a leading zero. ISBN-13 must use the 978 or 979 prefix. A valid ISBN-10 is also returned as ISBN-13, and a 978 ISBN-13 is also returned as ISBN-10. This does not check that the publisher prefix was ever assigned. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/isbn-validate
name: isbn_validate
title: Isbn Validate
